pageProps.title: Linux DRM - Code Flow of open() and ioctl()
pageProps.review: Explains how open() and ioctl() are processed within the kernel in Linux DRM (drm_stub_open, drm_file_alloc, drm_ioctl dispatch, and permission checks) with Linux v6.19 code and a libdrm example.
pageProps.description: The code path of open() and ioctl() in Linux DRM v6.19: drm_stub_open, drm_file_alloc, drm_ioctl dispatch and permission checks, plus a libdrm probe example.
